children: New Delhi, Oct. 24 -- Godrej Properties share price closed 4.23% lower on Friday, after the realty firm reported 62% annual decline in its consolidated net profit to Rs.154.15 crore for the quarter ended September. The decline in Q2 profit was driven by higher expenses.

Rising costs and earnings expansion in the short term is a key concern for the company, and investors will closely monitor how the firm will manage to turn its strengths in operations into profitability as projects come closer to completion, according to Siddharth Maurya, Founder & Managing Director, Vibhavangal Anukulakara Pvt. Ltd.

"A fall in Godrej Properties' Q2 net profit by 62% is clearly a red flag regarding the issue of rising costs and earnings expansion in the short term, but it doesn't really undermine the company's prospects in the long run. Healthy bookings, collection from customers, and the pipeline of new launches are indicative of the positive housing market trend," explained Maurya.

Apart from increasing costs and earnings expansion, investors will closely track company's strategy to turn its strengths in operations into profitability. "Construction cost escalation and execution timeline will still be crucial concerns. In the coming months, share price dynamics will be contingent upon margins, cash flows, and new launches," he added.

The Mumbai-headquartered realty firm announced a 62% decline in its consolidated net profit to Rs.154.15 crore for the quarter ended September. Its net profit stood at Rs.405.08 crore in the year-ago period.

Godrej Properties' total income rose to Rs.2,571.73 crore in the second quarter of the current fiscal from Rs.1,950.05 crore in the corresponding period of the preceding financial year, according to a regulatory filing.
The realty firm's total expenses surged to Rs.2,476.74 crore during the period under review compared to Rs.1,300.98 crore a year ago.
On the operational performance front, the company reported a 6% decline in its sales bookings or pre-sales to Rs.8,008 crore in July-September of FY27 from Rs.8,505 crore in the year-ago period.

Godrej Properties share price closed 1497.90 per share on BSE with an Mcap of Rs.45,120.72 crore on Friday, October 23. Its share price value has declined 26.65% in three months, 25.73% in 2026 so far. Its share price value has 34.23% in one year and around 49.41% in two years.
